items.title: Blue Door Bop
items.caption: Fast bebop jazz quartet instrumental. Agile alto saxophone playing a quick angular head and a blazing solo, fast walking upright bass, crisp ride cymbal with snare and bass drum accents, sharp piano comping and a piano solo. Exciting, virtuosic, a packed basement club. Warm vintage live recording. No vocals.

items.title: Shiomi Bossa
items.caption: Bossa nova jazz instrumental. Soft nylon-string guitar playing syncopated bossa chords, a warm flute melody, gentle piano fills, upright bass, light brushed drums with rim clicks and shaker. Relaxed, elegant, a sea breeze through an open cafe window. Warm natural recording. No vocals.

items.title: Kaburo Soul
items.caption: Soul jazz instrumental with a greasy shuffle groove. Hammond organ with rotary speaker playing the bluesy lead and bass pedals, clean hollow-body guitar comping and soloing, gritty tenor saxophone, backbeat drums. Funky, earthy, good-humoured. Warm vintage analog recording. No vocals.

items.title: Tuesday at the Kissa
items.caption: Medium swing jazz piano trio instrumental. Acoustic grand piano with a singing melodic touch and rich chord voicings, walking upright bass, light swinging brushes and ride cymbal, a bass solo and trading fours with the drums. Easygoing, warm, a quiet afternoon in a jazz cafe. Intimate natural recording. No vocals.

items.title: Asagiri Morning
items.caption: Modal jazz quartet instrumental. Soprano saxophone lead with long searching phrases, piano playing open quartal chords, a rolling upright bass vamp, loose polyrhythmic drums with shimmering cymbals. Spiritual, spacious, building in intensity. Warm vintage analog recording. No vocals.

items.title: Wangan Mambo
items.caption: Latin jazz instrumental. Congas, timbales and cowbell over a clave rhythm, a driving piano montuno, punchy trumpet and trombone horn lines, upright bass tumbao, a trumpet solo and a percussion break. Festive, hot, danceable. Warm vintage live recording. No vocals.

items.title: Sakura Waltz
items.caption: Jazz waltz instrumental, lyrical and light. Piano and hollow-body guitar sharing a graceful melody, upright bass, soft brushed drums in three-four time, a guitar solo then a piano solo. Wistful, gentle, cherry petals falling on a quiet street. Intimate natural recording. No vocals.

items.title: Tōto Express
items.caption: Big band swing instrumental. A full saxophone section trading riffs with bright trumpets and trombones, a shouting brass chorus, walking upright bass, swinging drums with big fills, rhythm guitar chords, a tenor saxophone solo and a trumpet solo. Exuberant, powerful, dance hall energy. Warm vintage recording. No vocals.

items.title: A Letter from Yūnagi
items.caption: Warm jazz ballad instrumental. Mellow flugelhorn lead with a soft round tone, tender piano accompaniment, upright bass playing long notes, whisper-quiet brushed drums, a short piano solo. Nostalgic, hopeful, sunset over the sea. Intimate natural recording. No vocals.

items.title: Takanodai Stroll
items.caption: Jazz guitar trio instrumental, medium swing with a bluesy feel. Warm hollow-body electric guitar playing the melody in octaves and a relaxed single-note solo, walking upright bass, swinging ride cymbal and brushes. Easy, sunny, strolling downhill on a Sunday. Warm vintage analog recording. No vocals.
